notes.title: BVRGames' new game My Boss Is Weird is officially available!
notes.notes:
"My boss is weird " is a workplace AVG choose gameplay as the core of the game, the game tells the story of a workplace white, inexplicably suspected of being a voyeur, in order to prove his innocence. The player is presented with a series of choices, some of which may seem small, but can lead to very different outcomes.

"My boss is weird " Store Page:https://store.steampowered.com/app/1506600/_/
